verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς πρωῒ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ γραμματέων καὶ τὸ ὅλον συνέδριον ποιήσαντες συμβούλιον δήσαντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπήνεγκαν καὶ παρέδωκαν Πιλάτῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys prōi hoi archiereis meta tōn presbyterōn kai grammateōn kai to holon synedrion poiēsantes symboulion dēsantes ton Iēsoun apēnenkan kai paredōkan Pilatō
verses.literal: - Early in the morning the chief priests - - elders - scribes and the whole Sanhedrin devised a plan They bound - Jesus led [Him] away and handed [Him] over to Pilate

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν εἶ Σὺ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων Σὺ λέγεις δὲ Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ λέγει
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Pilatos epērōtēsen auton ei Sy ho Basileus tōn Ioudaiōn Sy legeis de Ho apokritheis autō legei
verses.literal: So - Pilate questioned Him Are You the King of the Jews You have said so - - [Jesus] replied . . . . . .

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς κατηγόρουν αὐτοῦ πολλά
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi archiereis katēgoroun autou polla
verses.literal: And the chief priests began to accuse Him of many things

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν πάλιν λέγων Οὐκ ἀποκρίνῃ οὐδέν ἴδε πόσα κατηγοροῦσιν σου
verses.transliteration: de Ho Pilatos epērōta auton palin legōn Ouk apokrinē ouden ide posa katēgorousin sou
verses.literal: Then - Pilate questioned Him again . . . vvv Have You no answer . . . Look how many charges they are bringing against You

verses.original: δὲ ὥστε τὸν Πιλᾶτον θαυμάζειν Ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπεκρίθη οὐκέτι οὐδὲν
verses.transliteration: de hōste ton Pilaton thaumazein Ho Iēsous apekrithē ouketi ouden
verses.literal: But to - Pilate’s amazement - Jesus made no further reply . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ Κατὰ ἑορτὴν ἀπέλυεν αὐτοῖς ἕνα δέσμιον ὃν παρῃτοῦντο
verses.transliteration: de Kata heortēn apelyen autois hena desmion hon parētounto
verses.literal: Now {it was Pilate’s custom} at [the] feast to release to [the people] a prisoner vvv of their choosing

verses.original: δὲ ὁ λεγόμενος Βαραββᾶς ἦν δεδεμένος μετὰ τῶν στασιαστῶν οἵτινες πεποιήκεισαν φόνον ἐν τῇ στάσει
verses.transliteration: de ho legomenos Barabbas ēn dedemenos meta tōn stasiastōn hoitines pepoiēkeisan phonon en tē stasei
verses.literal: And [a man] named Barabbas was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection

verses.original: καὶ ὁ ὄχλος ἀναβὰς ἤρξατο αἰτεῖσθαι καθὼς ἐποίει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai ho ochlos anabas ērxato aiteisthai kathōs epoiei autois
verses.literal: [So] the crowd went up [and] began asking [Pilate] to keep his custom . . . . . .

verses.original: Θέλετε ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν τὸν Βασιλέα τῶν Ἰουδαίων δὲ Ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς λέγων
verses.transliteration: Thelete apolysō hymin ton Basilea tōn Ioudaiōn de Ho Pilatos apekrithē autois legōn
verses.literal: Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews - - Pilate asked . . . . . .

verses.original: γὰρ ἐγίνωσκεν διὰ φθόνον ὅτι οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς παραδεδώκεισαν αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: gar eginōsken dia phthonon hoti hoi archiereis paradedōkeisan auton
verses.literal: For he knew [it was] out of envy that the chief priests had handed [Jesus] over . . .

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἀνέσεισαν τὸν ὄχλον ἵνα ἀπολύσῃ τὸν Βαραββᾶν αὐτοῖς μᾶλλον
verses.transliteration: de Hoi archiereis aneseisan ton ochlon hina apolysē ton Barabban autois mallon
verses.literal: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release - Barabbas to them instead

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἀποκριθεὶς ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς πάλιν Τί οὖν θέλετε ποιήσω ὃν λέγετε τὸν Βασιλέα τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: de Ho Pilatos apokritheis elegen autois palin Ti oun thelete poiēsō hon legete ton Basilea tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: [So] - Pilate asked . . . them again What then do you want me to do with the [One] you call the King of the Jews

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ ἔκραξαν πάλιν Σταύρωσον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de Hoi ekraxan palin Staurōson auton
verses.literal: And - they shouted back Crucify Him

verses.original: γὰρ δὲ ἔλεγεν Ὁ Πιλᾶτος αὐτοῖς Τί κακόν ἐποίησεν δὲ Οἱ ἔκραξαν περισσῶς Σταύρωσον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: gar de elegen Ho Pilatos autois Ti kakon epoiēsen de Hoi ekraxan perissōs Staurōson auton
verses.literal: Why - asked - Pilate - What evil has He done But - they shouted all the louder Crucify Him

verses.original: δὲ βουλόμενος ποιῆσαι τὸ ἱκανὸν τῷ ὄχλῳ Ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἀπέλυσεν τὸν Βαραββᾶν αὐτοῖς καὶ τὸν Ἰησοῦν φραγελλώσας παρέδωκεν ἵνα σταυρωθῇ
verses.transliteration: de boulomenos poiēsai to hikanon tō ochlō Ho Pilatos apelysen ton Barabban autois kai ton Iēsoun phragellōsas paredōken hina staurōthē
verses.literal: And wishing to - satisfy the crowd - Pilate released - Barabbas to them But - {he had} Jesus flogged [and] handed Him over to be crucified

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ στρατιῶται ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν ἔσω τῆς αὐλῆς ὅ ἐστιν Πραιτώριον καὶ συνκαλοῦσιν τὴν ὅλην σπεῖραν
verses.transliteration: de Hoi stratiōtai apēgagon auton esō tēs aulēs ho estin Praitōrion kai synkalousin tēn holēn speiran
verses.literal: Then the soldiers led [Jesus] away . . . into the palace (that is [the] Praetorium and called the whole company {together}

verses.original: καὶ ἐνδιδύσκουσιν αὐτὸν πορφύραν καὶ πλέξαντες στέφανον ἀκάνθινον περιτιθέασιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai endidyskousin auton porphyran kai plexantes stephanon akanthinon perititheasin autō
verses.literal: - They dressed Him in a purple robe - twisted together a crown of thorns [and] set [it] on His [head]

verses.original: καὶ ἤρξαντο ἀσπάζεσθαι αὐτόν Χαῖρε Βασιλεῦ τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: kai ērxanto aspazesthai auton Chaire Basileu tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: And they began to salute Him Hail King of the Jews

verses.original: Καὶ ἔτυπτον αὐτοῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν καλάμῳ καὶ ἐνέπτυον αὐτῷ καὶ τιθέντες τὰ γόνατα προσεκύνουν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai etypton autou tēn kephalēn kalamō kai eneptyon autō kai tithentes ta gonata prosekynoun autō
verses.literal: - They kept striking His - head with a staff and spitting on Him And they knelt down . . . . . . [and] bowed before Him

verses.original: καὶ ὅτε ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ ἐξέδυσαν αὐτὸν τὴν πορφύραν καὶ ἐνέδυσαν αὐτοῦ ἴδια τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτὸν Καὶ ἐξάγουσιν αὐτὸν ἵνα σταυρώσωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai hote enepaixan autō exedysan auton tēn porphyran kai enedysan autou idia ta himatia auton Kai exagousin auton hina staurōsōsin auton
verses.literal: After . . . they had mocked Him they removed - the purple [robe] and put His own - clothes [back] on Him Then they led Him out . . . to crucify Him

verses.original: τινα Σίμωνα Κυρηναῖον τὸν πατέρα Ἀλεξάνδρου καὶ Ῥούφου παράγοντά ἐρχόμενον ἀπ’ ἀγροῦ Καὶ ἀγγαρεύουσιν ἵνα ἄρῃ τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: tina Simōna Kyrēnaion ton patera Alexandrou kai Rhouphou paragonta erchomenon ap’ agrou Kai angareuousin hina arē ton stauron autou
verses.literal: [Now] Simon of Cyrene the father of Alexander and Rufus was passing by on his way in from the country and [the soldiers] forced [him] to carry the cross of [Jesus]

verses.original: Καὶ φέρουσιν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον Γολγοθᾶν ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον τόπος Κρανίου
verses.transliteration: Kai pherousin auton epi ton topon Golgothan ho estin methermēneuomenon topos Kraniou
verses.literal: - They brought [Jesus] to - a place [called] Golgotha which vvv means [The] Place of the Skull

verses.original: καὶ ἐδίδουν αὐτῷ οἶνον ἐσμυρνισμένον δὲ ὃς οὐκ ἔλαβεν
verses.transliteration: kai edidoun autō oinon esmyrnismenon de hos ouk elaben
verses.literal: There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh but He vvv did not take [it]

verses.original: Καὶ σταυροῦσιν αὐτὸν καὶ διαμερίζονται αὐτοῦ τὰ ἱμάτια βάλλοντες κλῆρον ἐπ’ αὐτὰ τί τίς ἄρῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai staurousin auton kai diamerizontai autou ta himatia ballontes klēron ep’ auta ti tis arē
verses.literal: And they crucified Him vvv They also divided His - garments by casting lots to decide - what [each of them] would take

verses.original: δὲ Ἦν τρίτη ὥρα καὶ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de Ēn tritē hōra kai estaurōsan auton
verses.literal: - It was [the] third hour when they crucified Him

verses.original: καὶ ἡ αἰτίας ἐπιγραφὴ τῆς αὐτοῦ ἦν ἐπιγεγραμμένη Ο ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ ΤΩΝ ΙΟΥΔΑΙΩΝ
verses.transliteration: kai hē aitias epigraphē tēs autou ēn epigegrammenē HO BASILEUS TŌN IOUDAIŌN
verses.literal: And the charge inscribed - against Him vvv read THE KING OF THE JEWS

verses.original: Καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ σταυροῦσιν δύο λῃστάς ἕνα ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ ἕνα ἐξ αὐτοῦ εὐωνύμων
verses.transliteration: Kai syn autō staurousin dyo lēstas hena ek dexiōn kai hena ex autou euōnymōn
verses.literal: [Along] with [Jesus] they crucified two robbers one on [His] right and one on His left

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ παραπορευόμενοι ἐβλασφήμουν αὐτὸν κινοῦντες αὐτῶν τὰς κεφαλὰς καὶ λέγοντες Οὐὰ ὁ καταλύων τὸν ναὸν καὶ οἰκοδομῶν ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi paraporeuomenoi eblasphēmoun auton kinountes autōn tas kephalas kai legontes Oua ho katalyōn ton naon kai oikodomōn en trisin hēmerais
verses.literal: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him shaking their - heads and saying Aha - You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild [it] in three days

verses.original: καταβὰς ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ σῶσον σεαυτὸν
verses.transliteration: katabas apo tou staurou sōson seauton
verses.literal: come down from the cross [and] save Yourself

verses.original: Ὁμοίως καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς μετὰ τῶν γραμματέων ἐμπαίζοντες πρὸς ἀλλήλους ἔλεγον ἔσωσεν Ἄλλους οὐ δύναται σῶσαι ἑαυτὸν
verses.transliteration: Homoiōs kai hoi archiereis meta tōn grammateōn empaizontes pros allēlous elegon esōsen Allous ou dynatai sōsai heauton
verses.literal: In the same way . . . the chief priests and - scribes mocked [Him] among themselves saying He saved others vvv [but] He cannot save Himself

verses.original: ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ Βασιλεὺς Ἰσραὴλ καταβάτω νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ σταυροῦ ἵνα ἴδωμεν καὶ πιστεύσωμεν καὶ οἱ συνεσταυρωμένοι σὺν αὐτῷ ὠνείδιζον αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ho Christos ho Basileus Israēl katabatō nyn apo tou staurou hina idōmen kai pisteusōmen kai hoi synestaurōmenoi syn autō ōneidizon auton
verses.literal: {Let} the Christ the King of Israel come down now from the cross so that we may see and believe And even those who were crucified with Him berated Him

verses.original: Καὶ ἕκτης ὥρας γενομένης ἕως ἐνάτης ὥρας σκότος ἐγένετο ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: Kai hektēs hōras genomenēs heōs enatēs hōras skotos egeneto eph’ holēn tēn gēn
verses.literal: - From [the] sixth hour - until [the] ninth hour darkness came over all the land

verses.original: καὶ τῇ ἐνάτῃ ὥρᾳ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐβόησεν μεγάλῃ φωνῇ Ἐλωῒ Ἐλωῒ λεμὰ σαβαχθάνι ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον μου Ὁ Θεός μου ὁ Θεός εἰς τί ἐγκατέλιπές με
verses.transliteration: kai tē enatē hōra ho Iēsous eboēsen megalē phōnē Elōi Elōi lema sabachthani ho estin methermēneuomenon mou Ho Theos mou ho Theos eis ti enkatelipes me
verses.literal: - At the ninth hour - Jesus cried out vvv in a loud voice Eloi Eloi lema sabachthani which vvv means My - God My - God why . . . have You forsaken Me

verses.original: Καί τινες τῶν παρεστηκότων ἀκούσαντες ἔλεγον Ἴδε φωνεῖ Ἠλίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai tines tōn parestēkotōn akousantes elegon Ide phōnei Ēlian
verses.literal: When some of those standing nearby heard [this] they said Behold He is calling Elijah

verses.original: δέ τις Δραμὼν καὶ γεμίσας σπόγγον ὄξους περιθεὶς καλάμῳ ἐπότιζεν αὐτόν λέγων Ἄφετε ἴδωμεν εἰ Ἠλίας ἔρχεται καθελεῖν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de tis Dramōn kai gemisas spongon oxous peritheis kalamō epotizen auton legōn Aphete idōmen ei Ēlias erchetai kathelein auton
verses.literal: And someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine He put [it] on a reed and held it up for [Jesus] to drink . . . saying Leave [Him] alone Let us see if Elijah comes to take Him down . . .

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀφεὶς μεγάλην φωνὴν ἐξέπνευσεν
verses.transliteration: de Ho Iēsous apheis megalēn phōnēn exepneusen
verses.literal: But - Jesus let out vvv a loud cry [and] breathed His last

verses.original: Καὶ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐσχίσθη εἰς δύο ἀπ’ ἄνωθεν ἕως κάτω
verses.transliteration: Kai to katapetasma tou naou eschisthē eis dyo ap’ anōthen heōs katō
verses.literal: And the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom

verses.original: δὲ ὁ κεντυρίων ὁ παρεστηκὼς ἐξ ἐναντίας αὐτοῦ Ἰδὼν ὅτι οὕτως ἐξέπνευσεν εἶπεν Ἀληθῶς οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἦν Υἱὸς Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de ho kentyriōn ho parestēkōs ex enantias autou Idōn hoti houtōs exepneusen eipen Alēthōs houtos ho anthrōpos ēn Huios Theou
verses.literal: When the centurion - standing there vvv in front of [Jesus] saw - [how] He had breathed His last he said Truly this - man was [the] Son of God

verses.original: δὲ Ἦσαν καὶ γυναῖκες θεωροῦσαι ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἐν αἷς καὶ Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ μήτηρ Ἰακώβου τοῦ μικροῦ καὶ Ἰωσῆτος καὶ Σαλώμη
verses.transliteration: de Ēsan kai gynaikes theōrousai apo makrothen en hais kai Maria hē Magdalēnē kai Maria hē mētēr Iakōbou tou mikrou kai Iōsētos kai Salōmē
verses.literal: And there were also women watching from a distance Among them [were] Mary - Magdalene - Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses and Salome

verses.original: αἳ ἠκολούθουν αὐτῷ καὶ διηκόνουν αὐτῷ ὅτε ἦν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ καὶ πολλαὶ ἄλλαι αἱ συναναβᾶσαι εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: hai ēkolouthoun autō kai diēkonoun autō hote ēn en tē Galilaia kai pollai allai hai synanabasai eis Hierosolyma autō
verses.literal: [These women] had followed [Jesus] and ministered to Him while He was in - Galilee and [there were] many other [women] who had come up to Jerusalem with Him

verses.original: Καὶ γενομένης ἤδη ὀψίας ἐπεὶ ἦν Παρασκευή ὅ ἐστιν προσάββατον
verses.transliteration: Kai genomenēs ēdē opsias epei ēn Paraskeuē ho estin prosabbaton
verses.literal: Now it was already evening Since it was Preparation Day (that is [the day] before the Sabbath )

verses.original: Ἰωσὴφ ὁ ἀπὸ Ἁριμαθαίας εὐσχήμων βουλευτής ὃς αὐτὸς καὶ ἦν προσδεχόμενος τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ τολμήσας ἐλθὼν εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς τὸν Πιλᾶτον καὶ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Iōsēph ho apo Harimathaias euschēmōn bouleutēs hos autos kai ēn prosdechomenos tēn basileian tou Theou tolmēsas elthōn eisēlthen pros ton Pilaton kai ētēsato to sōma tou Iēsou
verses.literal: Joseph - of Arimathea [a] prominent Council member who himself . . . was waiting for the kingdom - of God boldly went . . . to - Pilate - to ask for the body - of Jesus

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἐθαύμασεν εἰ ἤδη τέθνηκεν καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τὸν κεντυρίωνα ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὸν εἰ ἀπέθανεν πάλαι
verses.transliteration: de Ho Pilatos ethaumasen ei ēdē tethnēken kai proskalesamenos ton kentyriōna epērōtēsen auton ei apethanen palai
verses.literal: - - Pilate was surprised [to hear] that vvv [Jesus] was already dead so he summoned the centurion to ask - if [this was so] . . .

verses.original: καὶ γνοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ κεντυρίωνος ἐδωρήσατο τὸ πτῶμα τῷ Ἰωσήφ
verses.transliteration: kai gnous apo tou kentyriōnos edōrēsato to ptōma tō Iōsēph
verses.literal: - When [Pilate] had confirmed [it] with the centurion he granted the body - to Joseph

verses.original: Καὶ ἀγοράσας σινδόνα καθελὼν αὐτὸν ἐνείλησεν τῇ σινδόνι καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸν ἐν μνημείῳ ὃ ἦν λελατομημένον ἐκ πέτρας καὶ προσεκύλισεν λίθον ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν τοῦ μνημείου
verses.transliteration: Kai agorasas sindona kathelōn auton eneilēsen tē sindoni kai ethēken auton en mnēmeiō ho ēn lelatomēmenon ek petras kai prosekylisen lithon epi tēn thyran tou mnēmeiou
verses.literal: So [Joseph] bought a linen cloth took down [the body of Jesus] wrapped [it] in the cloth and placed [it] in a tomb that had been cut out of [the] rock Then he rolled a stone against the entrance to the tomb

verses.original: δὲ ἡ Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ Ἰωσῆτος ἐθεώρουν ποῦ τέθειται
verses.transliteration: de hē Maria hē Magdalēnē kai Maria hē Iōsētos etheōroun pou tetheitai
verses.literal: - - Mary - Magdalene and Mary the [mother] of Joseph saw where [His body] was placed
